{{Quote|I'm hard-headed. It is my greatest strength. And my strength has never failed me.|Saesee Tiin|<ref name="HMJ">{{CWACite|1|Heavy Metal Jedi}}</ref>}}
'''Saesee Tiin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] in the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Having apprenticed under the esteemed Jedi Master [[Omo Bouri/Legends|Omo Bouri]], Tiin rarely spoke and kept to himself. Never choosing to take a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] himself, Tiin took the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Tiin fought in the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] during the [[Fifth Battle of Qotile|fifth battle]] on [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]] and also participated in the [[Yinchorri Uprising]] of [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. Some time after that, he and other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] tracked down the terrorist [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] movement to their base on [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]]. Tiin fought on many battlefronts during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on planets such as [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], [[Gwori]], [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], [[Diado]], [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and [[The Rig]].

A renowned [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Jedi ace|ace]], Tiin had been born on [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Iktotchon/Legends|Iktotchon]]. Because of the battering winds of the moon, Tiin's species had adapted toughened skin and blunt features. Tiin was a starfighter instructor for younglings, where he taught many younglings the basics of flying. A natural [[Telepathy/Legends|telepath]], Master Tiin failed to foresee his demise at the hands of the secret [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who in reality, was [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Tiin's death on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] alongside that of [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] to Darth Sidious marked the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:SaeseeTiin-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|180px|Saesee Tiin]]
Born on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]], Saesee Tiin was introduced to piloting during his youngest years, appearing to be a natural [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> When [[Jedi recruiter|scouts]] from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] identified the young boy as a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], he was turned over to the Order for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at the [[Jedi academy|academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Raised within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Tiin found it embarrassing when his natural [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] abilities were ridiculed by his peers. While they believed these powers gave him an unfair advantage at the academy, Tiin believed it was more of a hindrance as he had yet to learn to control his abilities. Tiin would admit, however, that his abilities gave him an edge during [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] training as his opponents unwittingly revealed their strategy through their thoughts. Because of his unique abilities, Tiin was shunned by his peers and became extremely reclusive. As Tiin learned to home in on particular minds, he came to the attention of the [[Wol Cabasshite/Legends|Wol Cabasshite]] Jedi Councilor, Master [[Omo Bouri/Legends|Omo Bouri]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

After [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduating]] from the academy, Tiin accepted Bouri's offer of apprenticeship and became a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Master Bouri was unique himself, as he communicated through phonemic energy pulses with syntactic contours in a magnetic field that he controlled with his tongue. Because Bouri's brain was so evolved, Tiin found himself faced with something completely new: a brain he couldn't understand. Intrigued, he focused all his time coming to understand his master and to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to expand his telepathy to extraordinary heights. Able to control his own mind and sift through thoughts from around the galaxy, Tiin also learned from Bouri the meaning of complete dedication to the Order.<ref name="JvS" /> Traveling with his master for years and eventually passing the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], Tiin was made a full [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. When Master Bouri was lost on an ill-fated mission, Tiin refused to speak at the Jedi's [[Jedi funeral/Legends|funeral]] and fell into a long period of isolation. While secluded, Tiin pursued the path of the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardians]], honing his skills as an [[Jedi ace|ace]] pilot in the [[Jedi Starfighter Corps]].<ref name="db" />

Despite the importance that his own master had played in his life, Saesee Tiin refused to accept a Padawan of his own, despite the encouragement of Jedi [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Instead Tiin turned further inward, searching for ways to commune with his deceased Master through the Force. Whether Tiin ever did so is unknown, but much of his time as a Knight was poured into this endeavor.<ref name="JvS" />

===Jedi Master===
{{Quote|He talks more to that starship than he does to me.|Adi Gallia|<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Saesee_Tiin_TPM.png|thumb|right|180px|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Saesee Tiin.]]
Eventually, after a distinguished career, Saesee Tiin was promoted to the rank of Master by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]]. After long deliberation, the Council invited Tiin to take a seat on the Council as a long-term member. Not long after, Master Tiin was on Coruscant when the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] broke out; along with the other Councilors present, he aided Padawan [[Sha Koon]] channel trapped Republic soldiers and Jedi during the fighting. As the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] preparing an attack against [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark's]] forces, Tiin, with his astonishing flying skills and firm leadership, was an obvious choice to command the fighter squadron. He led [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red]] and [[Blue Squadron (Jedi Order)|Blue Squadrons]] to victory in the [[Fifth Battle of Qotile]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: The Stark Hyperspace War">''[[Star Wars: The Stark Hyperspace War]]''</ref>

On numerous occasions, Master Tiin's flying skills saved the lives of his fellow Jedi. When a [[Yinchorri Uprising|war]] erupted in the [[Yinchorri system]] a communication was sent to the High Council. After the transmission ended, the Council discussed the course of action to take. Mace Windu then formed three Jedi teams which were dispatched to find the [[Yinchorri command center]]. Piloting the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] with Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] as co-pilot, they were ambushed above the planet by [[Yinchorri attack ship]]s. Entering the world's gravity well, Tiin used his enhanced Force abilities to take an extremely dangerous course of action: he engaged the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and went around the planet at hyperspeed. Successfully making the jump, Tiin landed the shuttle on the planet and went into [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] with Master Windu on a [[mesa]] while Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and Padawan Kenobi went to reconnoiter the surrounding area. It wasn't long before the team was forced to engage the Yinchorri warriors, fighting for their lives as the other two teams converged on the planet. As Masters [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] and [[Micah Giiett]]'s teams arrived to divert the attack, Master Tiin advanced on one of the Yinchorri tanks and disabled it so his allies could proceed to the rescue ship. Taking the ship up when the survivors were all aboard, Master Tiin piloted the ship to space where it was joined by the Navy. When the Council contacted the teams, Tiin took the ship the coordinates provided, the interior of the planet [[Uhanayih]], where the command center was located. With the command center secured by the Navy, Tiin and the other survivors returned to Coruscant.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War]]''</ref>

[[File:Spiralstarfighter.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The ''[[Sharp Spiral]]'', Saesee Tiin's personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
Master Tiin kept a personal fighter he had been given by a group of grateful [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] diplomats. Naming the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Cutlass-9 patrol fighter]] the ''[[Sharp Spiral]]'', Tiin piloted it on several missions, and stored it within the Temple docking complex. Constantly updating all of its systems, Tiin removed the electronic sensor and map systems from the databases. It was in ''Sharp Spiral'' that Master Tiin performed one of his most famous deeds. For some years, Tiin had established close links with a group of independent conscience-fighters called the [[Sons and Daughters of Freedom]]. The group fought for the cause of liberty and were usually allies of the Republic. However, when a faction within the Freedom's Sons became corrupt, Tiin set out to apprehend them. It was an unbalanced fight&mdash;Tiin in ''Sharp Spiral'' and the rogue Freedom's Sons in three battleships. Despite outgunning the Iktotchi many times over, the renegades could not land a single shot on ''Sharp Spiral''. With cool calm, Tiin went about destroying the shields, engines, and weapons systems of all three ships. He then left the ships stranded for the Republic forces to pick up.<ref name="NEGVV" />

Master Tiin dueled with Kenobi in the Jedi Temple prior to the the [[Mission to Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|Mission to Onderon]]. Kenobi was able to defeat Tiin.<ref name="SW:OW">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref>

Tiin kept his place on the High Council. Although he was often silent, the advice he did offer was valued for its directness and foresight; this did not stop some from questioning his usefulness on the august body.<ref name="db" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Tiin led a Jedi team to [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] to investigate a lead on the attempted assassination of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. Negotiating with port authority, their shuttle was attacked by the fighters of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] terrorist group and Tiin and his fellows crash-landed in a lake. Swimming to shore, Master Tiin and the other Jedi set up camp in ruins on the island and waited to engage their attackers. Following a slave of the [[House Vandron]] down a secret passage in the temple, the Jedi were led to the mainland where they entered a small city held by the Nebula Front militia that had taken hold of the surrounding areas. Surrounded by the terrorists the Jedi agreed to a temporary truce, but when the guards opened fire on the slaves that had led the Jedi to the mainland, Tiin and the other Masters agreed to annul the agreement and engage the troopers. Charging then retreating, then charging again, Tiin and his peers moved to take several starfighters when reinforcements from [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] arrived and killed or scattered the remaining terrorists. Ordering the other Jedi back to Coruscant, Tiin rebuked Master Jinn for defying his orders and heading to the planet [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]] aboard the confiscated [[Hawk-Bat (gunship)|''Hawk-Bat'']]. Later Tiin was dispatched to Eriadu for the [[Eriadu Trade Summit|Trade Summit]] there in order to protect the Supreme Chancellor from the Nebula Front's assassination attempts. Discovering that the droids in the midst of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] delegation were sabotaged to carry out the assault, Tiin led Padawan Kenobi and Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] to guard the Federation members. However, the members of the board activated their own force-shield, causing the droids' fire to eviscerate them as the Jedi watched helplessly.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

While Tiin had predicted the fall of Valorum's political career, he incorrectly guessed that [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] or [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] would replace him. However other forces were at work and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] took the title of Chancellor during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] of his own world by the Trade Federation. During the crisis, Master Tiin was present on Coruscant when Master Jinn brought word of an attack by a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|assassin]] he believed to be a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Wary of the return of the long extinct Sith, the Council was even more shocked by reports of a vergence in the Force surrounding a child, one [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Testing the boy, the Council voted not to train him because of his age; Master Tiin had been one of the few to vote yes to train the boy along with Master [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] who also entered the Order at an advanced age. It wasn't until Master Jinn was slain by the Sith that the Council reconsidered its earlier decision. With newly knighted Kenobi taking Skywalker as a Padawan, Tiin joined the rest of the Council on Naboo for the [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral]] of Master Jinn.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

While on Naboo, Tiin investigated the Sith assassin's personal craft after several [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] officers were killed trying to infiltrate it. Gaining access to the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']], Tiin found several [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] and recommended that it be turned over to the Order's specialists for study immediately. Before it could be studied further, the ship was lost in transit to [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].<ref name="NEGVV" />

[[File:Saesee_Infiltrator.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tiin investigates the ''Scimitar''.]]
Over the next ten years Master Tiin retained his seat on the Council, though his service was continually questioned as he contributed little to the discussion. He was consulted by [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] Windu regarding Jedi [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]' [[Mission to Kiffex|mission]] to [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]]; while Tiin was a supporter of Vos, he did not think the mission was a good idea for someone so close to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Master Windu considered this but ultimately ignored Tiin's advice.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Darkness">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref> Well versed in the history of the rogue military leader [[Ashaar Khorda]], Tiin helped inform his fellow Councilor's of the [[Annoo-dat]] general's background. Unfortunately this did not prevent the death of Master [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] at Khorda's hands on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself; Tiin attended the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian's]] [[Funeral of Yarael Poof|funeral]].<ref name="Star Wars: Zam Wesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref>

Shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], Saesee Tiin supervised the creation of a corps of Jedi starfighter pilots and collaborated with [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] to develop a new model to replace the Jedi Order's outdated [[Delta-6 Sprite-class starfighter|Delta-6]] starfighters.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Master Tiin helped fellow Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] flight-test a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite'']] prototype over Coruscant during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. Thanks to this trial, Saesee Tiin made several modifications to the starfighters for increased performance before they were introduced to the Temple's Starfighter Corps.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref> When Jedi Kenobi was captured on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Tiin joined with his [[Jedi assault team/Legends|fellow Jedi]] to rescue him. Arriving on the dusty world, Tiin fought through droves of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the [[Petranaki arena]] to rescue Kenobi, Padawan Skywalker, and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Though briefly surrounded by droids, Tiin and the survivors were rescued by the timely arrival of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and the recently discovered [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Joining Masters [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Roth-Del Masona]], and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] on a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|new Republic gunship]], the Jedi flew out into the field to engage the droids on the plains.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
====Years of war====
{{Quote|I can fly anything&hellip;|Saesee Tiin, to [[Na-Jia]]|<ref name="ITAT">{{CWACite|6|It Takes a Thief}}</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_of_Iktotch2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tiin fighting alongside Windu]]
With the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] underway, Tiin took up the mantle of Jedi General within the ranks of the Grand Army of the Republic. Heavily involved with the Order's fleet of starfighters, Tiin leveled great praise on the work of Jedi Skywalker, whose constant upgrades to the fleet was a great improvement to the original models. Encouraging the High Council to implement the boy's adjustments across all of the Starfighter Corps, Tiin was one of the first to obtain a [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]]. Continuing to pilot his personal starship, the ''Sharp Spiral'', Tiin was forced into a low-altitude ejection during an early battle and sustained several non-life threatening injuries, including the breaking of one of his cranial horns.<ref name="db" />

Recovering quickly from his wounds, Tiin accompanied Master Windu into battle when the war [[Battle of Iktotch|spread]] to Tiin's homeworld, Iktotch. Routing the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] that had taken hold there, Tiin preferred a tough approach to defeating the prototype [[B3 ultra battle droid]] as opposed to Windu's calculated attacks. Despite their different styles, the two Masters were able to cooperate and defeat the CIS armies on the planet.<ref name="HMJ" /> Tiin flew into battle in several prominent missions throughout the war, including leading a bombing run during the [[Battle of Gwori]],<ref name="The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom">''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''</ref> an [[Mission to Diado|assignment]] over [[Diado]],<ref name="ITAT" /> [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|the battles of Lola Sayu]],<ref name="Citadel Rescue">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Umbara]],<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref> and [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|Boz Pity]].<ref name="Star Wars: Obsession">''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]''</ref>

====Mission to the Rig====
[[File:SaeseeTiin-CitadelRescue.png|thumb|right|250px|Saesee Tiin piloting his starfighter at Lola Sayu]]
Tiin's bond with Master Windu grew throughout the Clone Wars. On an undercover mission, Tiin and Windu were joined by Masters [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], and together [[Mission to the Rig|infiltrated]] the [[Crimson Nova]]'s base known as [[the Rig]]. Because of the gang's involvement in a recent bout of Jedi slayings and the issuance of bounties on additional Jedi, the Council dispatched the team to get to the bottom of the crisis. Posing as a smuggler, Tiin boarded the Rig and joined Windu in the cantina while his comrades cause problems in the detention level. As he assumed, the dockhands unloaded his cargo into the Rig's storage facilities without notifying him; Tiin had anticipated this and had loaded the crates with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]], triggering it to explode and cause more distraction aboard the space station as the hangars were destroyed. Joining his comrades at the station's command deck, the four masters confronted the Crimson Nova's leader, [[Mika (Farghul)|Mika]]. As she refused to surrender, the Masters engaged the bounty hunters protecting the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] woman. While Windu and Fisto went after Mika, Tiin and Kolar took the control room and discovered the bounty hunter offering the Jedi bounties. Tracking their lead on [[Kh'aris Fenn]] to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], the Jedi found the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dead at the hands of [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. Disgusted by the scene, Tiin regretted his support of Vos, as it seemed incontrovertible that Vos had fallen into darkness.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Show of Force">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Show of Force]]''</ref>

====Duties of a Master====
[[File:RebelsAndTheCouncil-AWOTF.png|thumb|left|250px|Lux Bonteri and Saw Gerrera request assistance for the rebels from the Jedi High Council.]]
While serving the Republic valiantly, Master Tiin was a Jedi first and a General second. Sitting on the High Council of Jedi Order came with a multitude of responsibilities, including listening to intelligence reports and dictating Republic troop movements. Early in the war, Master Tiin was assigned to prevent the transfer of the [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]] fleet of [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaughts]] to the Confederacy. Joined by Master Koon and Jedi Skywalker, Tiin oversaw the Republic fleet as Koon negotiated with fleet commander [[Jace Dallin]] aboard the ''[[Mersel Kebir]]''. When [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mellor Yago]] of the [[Independent Provisional Government of Rendili]] arrested Koon and Dallin as traitors, Master Tiin's orders were clear: destroy the Rendili fleet if it refused to join the Republic's Army. While Skywalker offered an alternative, the strategy debate was interrupted by the arrival of Master Kenobi and the rogue Jedi Quinlan Vos. Igniting his lightsaber, Tiin demanded Vos be imprisoned before he headed to his starfighter. With the Separatist armada entering the fray, Tiin engaged the enemy fleet while his fellow Jedi led an unorthodox rescue mission which saw the salvaging of the Rendili fleet and the rescue of Master Koon. When the Separatists were repelled, Tiin returned to his flagship to deal with Vos. Deciding to take Vos to Coruscant, Tiin sat on the [[Council of Reconciliation/Legends|Council of Reconciliation]] as they tried Master Vos for his crimes. While Tiin deferred his decision to Master [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], the Council voted in favor of Vos and he was allowed to remain in the Order.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref>

As the war drummed along, more and more Jedi fell in the fighting. As a member of the High Council, Tiin participated in the [[Funeral of Halsey|funerals of Masters]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]], [[Funeral of the Jedi Temple bombing victims/Legends|the six Jedi]] killed in the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing of the Jedi Temple]], and the [[Funeral of Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|mock funeral]] for Master Kenobi before Kenobi embarked on an undercover mission. During the [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|trial of]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], refused to show leniency claiming that too much evidence was against her in the bombing of the Temple, with Tiin pointing out that Tano had been found in possession of nano-droids that had been involved in the attack.

====Battle of Coruscant====
{{Quote|The Dark Lord has revealed himself, and we dare not hesitate. Think not of if, Master Fisto; this duty has fallen to us. We will suffice.|Tiin prepares to face Palpatine|<ref name="ROTSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
{{Main|Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Showdown on Coruscant}}
[[File:SaeseeTiin.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Saesee Tiin during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]]]
In the final days of the war, Tiin was stationed on Coruscant as Chancellor Palpatine announced his moving of the [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Defense Fleet]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. While his fellow Masters discussed the ramifications of the move with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], Tiin sat in quiet reflection of the events.<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> Days later, the skies of Coruscant erupted in [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|blasterfire]] as the Separatists launched a surprise attack on the capital. Tiin took to his green Eta-2 and led a squadron of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] into the orbital battle between the Republic's [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] and the Confederacy's [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]], led by the feared droid leader General Grievous. When a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] collided with the ''[[Impavid/Legends|Impavid]]'' during a hyperspace exit, he landed in the dying [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and led its stranded [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|Jet troopers]] to take an enemy cruiser, the ''[[Prosperous/Legends|Prosperous]]''. With a specialized [[Environment suit/Legends|space suit]] Tiin jumped out of the lower rear [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] with his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and landed on the attacking Confederate [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. Tiin cut through the floor of the ship's landing bay, allowing him and his forces to enter the interior of the ship, eliminate its minor crew and take control.<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''</ref>

After the battle, Tiin returned to the Temple to help coordinate the rest of the war. It wasn't long, however before Master Kenobi reported Grievous' death on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]; coupled with Dooku's recent demise the Council deemed Palpatine's rule to be at an end. Tiin joined Masters Windu, Fisto and Kolar to journey to the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's office]] in an attempt to get Palpatine to relinquish his emergency powers peacefully. Before they exited the Temple, Jedi Skywalker approached the Masters and informed them that Palpatine was in fact the elusive [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Knowing their duty, the Masters headed to the office to arrest Palpatine. Before the Masters headed to the Chancellor's office, Fisto briefly talked to Tiin claiming that he would feel much calmer if Masters Kenobi, Plo Koon and Yoda had been with them. Tiin scolded Fisto for this because Tiin said that they were sufficient for the task, and that they were capable of subduing Palpatine.<ref name="ROTSN" />

[[File:The_Death_of_Saesee_Tiin.png|thumb|right|200px|Tiin's death at the hands of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]]]

When the Masters entered the office, Windu declared to Palpatine that he was under arrest.<ref name="ROTS" /> Moments after the Masters ignited their lightsabers, the Sith Lord accused the Jedi of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] and ignited [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers/Legends|his own lightsaber]]. Lunging at the four Jedi, Palpatine [[Shiak|stabbed]] Kolar before he could defend himself.<ref name="ROTS" /> As Kolar fell, Tiin saw his chance and attempted to strike the Sith Lord from behind, but was slashed at the waist when Palpatine turned to face him.<ref name="ROTS" /> Fisto and due to Skywalker's betrayal, Windu were also killed, heralding the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and the rise of the Sith to galactic dominance.<ref name="ROTSN" />

===Legacy===
Master Tiin's service to the galaxy would be largely erased by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of the Great Purge. Yet Tiin's memory was not totally lost. Soon after Tiin's death, Senator Organa retrieved his [[Jedi beacon transceiver]] from the ''Sharp Spiral'' in order to rescue Masters Yoda and Kenobi during the initial hours of the Purge.<ref name="ROTSN" /> In addition [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the man who would eventually rebuild the [[New Jedi Order|Order]], discovered a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] with a recording of Tiin's longest lecture at the Temple.<ref name="JvS" />

In the subsequent years of the Empire's reign, the insane Master [[Kazdan Paratus]] erected a [[Junk Temple|replica]] of the Temple on the junk world of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. Within the makeshift Council chamber, Paratus built a puppet that resembled Master Tiin, and the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] interacted with the characters as if they were alive. Paratus' illusion was shattered upon the arrival of the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], who systematically destroyed the Temple and the Tiin puppet.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Due to his telepathic abilities, Tiin was initially shunned by his peers, causing him to withdraw from most contact with the other students at the Temple. Maintaining his reclusive behavior throughout the rest of his training, Tiin was few of words and preferred to let others do the talking, though he was capable at forcing negotiations through during a crisis. While hard-headed, Master Tiin claimed that trait as his greatest strength and a valuable tool on the battlefield. 

Tiin was dedicated to the Jedi Order, a trait he attributed to his master, Omo Bouri. After Bouri's death, Tiin devoted much time toward an effort to communicate with his spirit.<ref name="JvS" /> 

Tiin reviled dark siders and traitors to the Order, going so far as to refuse to call [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] by name during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] after his apparent defection. Calling him simply "renegade," Tiin could not vote when Vos was brought before the Council of Reconciliation, believing himself too conflicted.<ref name="db" />

As the member of the Jedi Council Tiin was one of the Jedi who, due to the pressure of the galactic senate, expelled [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] from the Order to stand a military trial when it was believed that she [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|attacked]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and killed [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]]. Since she was found in possession(proximity) of the explosive [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]] and with all the other circumstantial yet convincing evidence that indicated she was guilty, Tiin believed all of it to be enough to convict her. After Tano was proven innocent and the [[Barriss Offee/Legends|real culprit]] [[Duel at the Jedi Temple/Legends|apprehended]], Tiin was apologetic to Tano.

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|You can't smash your way through the entire droid army&hellip;''"<br />"''Watch me.|Mace Windu and Saesee Tiin|<ref name="HMJ" />}}
[[File:Tiin_saber.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Saesee Tiin's lightsaber]]
Having trained as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]], Saesee Tiin possessed exceptional prowess with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], wielding many over his long career. Having used a violet, cobalt, and then an emerald [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] in his weapon's hilt, the Master was known for utilizing Form V, in particular Djem So.<ref name="db" /> Tiin was also well adept at [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]], tackling an enemy with either his arms or his legs.<ref name="HMJ" /><ref name="ITAT" /> He had enough strength to crush the head of a battle droid against a wall with one elbow.<ref name="HMJ" /> He could use the Force to throw droids for four kilometers.<ref name="HMJ" />

Aside from combat, Tiin was most comfortable as a pilot, serving the [[Jedi Starfighter Corps]] as an [[Jedi ace|ace pilot]]. Upgrading many of the Order's craft, Tiin was said to be rivaled only by Jedi Anakin Skywalker in his natural piloting skills. Enhanced by his natural telepathic abilities, Tiin was able to not only read minds, but [[Instinctive astrogation|instinctively astrogate]] his starfighters through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] without a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]].<ref name="db" /> His [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] prowess ranged from throwing heavy objects to slowing missiles and redirecting them at the ones who fired them.<ref name="HMJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SaeseeTiinConceptArt.jpg|thumb|150px|Early concept art for Saesee Tiin.]]
In the [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization of ''Revenge of the Sith'']], Tiin switched places with [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] in who was fatally wounded first. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], pretending to be in a panic over the threat of his arrest, asked Master Tiin: "Master Tiin, you're the telepath. Tell me what I'm thinking right now." Tiin was trying to read Palpatine's mind and Palpatine caught him off guard and beheaded him. In the first draft for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith]], Tiin was to be killed alongside [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] ([[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] faced [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] alone in this draft).<ref name="The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>

The ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'' erroneously states that Tiin was killed in the [[First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>

===Portrayal===
Saesee Tiin was portrayed/voiced by a number of actors: [[Khan Bonfils]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], [[Jesse Jensen]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] (as well as the brother of [[Zachariah Jensen]]&mdash;the actor that played [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] in the same movie), [[Kenji Oates]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], [[Joe Paulino]] in [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] and ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]'', [[Terrence Carson]] (the actor that also voiced [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]) in ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', and [[Dee Bradley Baker]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
